text:
Noah: Huge shoutout to @Priya for jumping on the rollback during lunch and keeping customer-facing logs clean. Literally a demo-saver. :confetti_ball:
Priya: Oh man, it was messy but we got the tail-end of the deploy under control. Teamwork FTW. :raised_hands:
Sam: Priya is the best. Want to nominate for the weekly kudos? I can add a note to the all-hands slide. :star2:
Ellen: Yes please! Also, snack reward poll: cider, kombucha, or mini cupcakes? React with :apple_cider:, :tumbler_glass:, or :cupcake: and I'll order based on votes.
Noah: Mini cupcakes for the win. (I will personally eat one on Priya's behalf.) :cupcake:
Priya: I do accept cupcakes. But genuinely no need, happy to help. If useful I can paste the short rollback checklist I used into #eng-ops.
gif-bot: posts "celebration" gif
Sam: gif-bot coming through. :laughing:
ops-bot: Note: rollback logged as INC-2897, autoscaler adjustments recorded. Tagging @Priya and @Noah.
Ellen: Thanks ops-bot. Priya—if you drop the checklist I can turn it into a tiny runbook snippet and pin it to the channel. :pushpin:
Priya: Will do in the morning. Also funny anecdote: the prod-like test account had a typo, so I'm renaming it "this-is-not-prod" now. :sweat_smile:
Noah: Love it. Ok cupcakes are currently ahead. Thanks again Priya, big appreciated. We'll put you on the shoutouts slide for Friday. :trophy:
